newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares barely changed in uninspired trade.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares barely changed in uninspired trade.

text.p: Istanbul shares ended barely lower on Monday as the market could not overcome fresh resistance at around the index's 1,670 level due to a lack of inspiring expectations or news, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 closed three points, or 0.18 percent easier at 1,651 after moving between 1,640 and 1,675.
The index had rallied 10 34 percent last week on privatisation hopes and good sentiment after the fading of political tension the previous week.
Trade volume jumped to 40.73 trillion lira ($321.5 million) from Friday's 32.93 trillion ($261.1 million).

"The index was stuck in a narrow range despite liquidity influx which was not bad. There is no expectation left to drive the market, so activity was share-based," said Cem Baycan from Delta securities.
